reject.title: Reject application
reject.description: You're rejecting the application from {name}. The note is optional and will be sent to the user.

revoke.roleFailed: Approval removed, but the bot couldn't remove the role. Remove it by hand in Discord.
revoke.success: Approval removed. The person can apply again now.
revoke.hint: Lets the person apply again and removes the approved role, if there is one.
